definitions: To make a hole in something using a drill, penetrating its surface.
To repeatedly teach or train someone in something until they know it perfectly or automatically.
To force an idea or concept into someone's mind through persistent repetition.
examples: The carpenter drilled into the wood.
The coach drilled the plays into the team.
The importance of safety was drilled into us.
pastTenses: drilled into (simple past), drilled into (past perfect)
